title: Gaussian Process Differential Ensembles for Joint Inference on Curves, Derivatives, and Integrals
summary: Functional data are often modeled through one likelihood-linked curve, while the scientific target is a larger state containing rates, accumulated quantities, boundary values, or nonlinear functionals of several linked levels. These targets require more than smoothing the observed curve: derivative uncertainty, cross-level covariance, and integration constants must be handled jointly. We introduce anchored Gaussian process differential ensembles, embedding an anchor \(f_0\) in a joint Gaussian state with its mean-square derivatives and repeated integrals.
